creator: noevarner.ai
title: /analyze-content Claude Code skill: paste any video URL, it downloads the video, extracts frames, transcribes audio and writes a shot-by-shot breakdown, hook analysis and 8-factor virality scorecard to recreate competitor reels

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: runs the skill; output saved as markdown to Google Drive ('Vidrush reel viral breakdown - MD')

claims: Pipeline: download video -> pull every frame -> transcribe audio -> hand everything to Claude -> full analysis
Output gives the hook, a text-hook idea and 'exactly why it went viral' so you can recreate it
'This is exactly how people are going mega viral on social media using AI'
how_to_steps: Install the skill into Claude Code

Read the generated report: timestamped table (Time, Visual, Spoken/Caption words, On-screen text style, Edit/Transition), '2. THE HOOK' (verbal, text, visual, curiosity, emotional), '3. VIRALITY ANALYSIS' scores
on_screen_only: Report table rows e.g. '0-1s Split screen: illustrated hand pressing a big red button... Bold white caption, dark pill background... Hard cut'
Hook section: Verbal hook 'You can now make full documentaries with one AI tool'; Text hook; Visual hook (hand-drawn finger on glowing red button); Curiosity hook; Emotional hook

Virality scores /10: Scroll-stopping power 7, Hook strength 8, Curiosity 8, Retention potential 7, Relatability 6, Emotional response 5, Novelty 7, Shareability 4 ('All scores are structural/predictive... I have no view/like/comment data')
Skill picker showing 'insights - Generate a report analyzing your Claude...' and '/anal' autocomplete; file saved to Google Drive
'COMMENT REPO'; whiteboard with content-system diagrams; 496,608 views badge
cta: Comment 'repo' for the repo and skill

relevance.why: This is essentially the tiktok-ai-research pipeline Haji already runs (download, frames, transcript, structured extraction) packaged as a reusable skill with a hook/virality rubric; useful for marketing his own apps.

implement_score.why: Haji already has the extraction pipeline; adding a /analyze-content skill wrapper with the hook + 8-factor rubric is an afternoon's work and reuses existing code. Repo itself is comment-gated, so build rather than fetch.

verify: Which downloader/transcriber the skill uses (yt-dlp, whisper?) and whether Instagram/TikTok downloads keep working
Scores are LLM guesses with no engagement data - treat as a checklist, not a predictor

gap.what: A packaged video-analysis skill with an explicit hook taxonomy and virality rubric; liked set had Apify hook scraping and Manus content-strategist prompts but not frame+transcript analysis inside Claude Code.
